_comment: Frontend mutation campaign. `mutate` is the OBSERVED scope -- what the nightly report-only campaign measures. mutation-enforced-scope.txt is the narrower ENFORCED tier that may gate a pull request. See docs/decisions/0013-frontend-mutation-tiers.md.
vitest_comment: `related` narrows each run with `vitest related`, which resolves nothing here -- the dry run then finds no tests at all -- so it stays off and perTest coverage does the narrowing instead.
concurrency_comment: Left to Stryker's default of one runner per core minus one, so the nightly adapts to whatever the runner has. Pass --concurrency to override on a busy machine.
thresholds_comment: Reporting only. The pull-request gate lives in scripts/mutation_gate.py, which reads mutation-report.json for the enforced scope; `break` stays null so the nightly observed campaign cannot fail on a score.
